hypotheses.mechanism: checkout-svc's new version 1.9.0 introduced a change in the HTTP client retry policy that causes excessive retries on payment-svc

cause.statement: checkout-svc version 1.9.0 (commit e7a0cc0) increased retry count from 1 to 4 and changed retry conditions to include 5xx responses

runtime_effect.statement: checkout-svc starts retrying payment-svc requests up to 4 times with a backoff of 0ms between attempts

symptom.statement: checkout-svc error rate spikes to 32% due to payment-svc timeouts and retries

hypotheses.mechanism: payment-svc's new version 2.4.1 introduced a bug that causes high error rates when handling checkout-svc requests

cause.statement: payment-svc version 2.4.1 (deployment d-533) has a bug that increases error rates

runtime_effect.statement: payment-svc starts returning 5xx errors more frequently due to a bug in the new version

symptom.statement: checkout-svc error rate spikes to 32% due to payment-svc errors

hypotheses.mechanism: checkout-svc's new version 1.9.0 introduced a change in the HTTP client timeout that causes payment-svc requests to time out

cause.statement: checkout-svc version 1.9.0 (commit e7a0cc0) increased the default timeout from 2000ms to 2500ms

runtime_effect.statement: checkout-svc requests to payment-svc time out more frequently due to longer timeouts

symptom.statement: checkout-svc error rate spikes to 32% due to payment-svc timeouts

parsed.rationale: The evidence shows that checkout-svc version 1.9.0 (commit e7a0cc0) increased the retry count from 1 to 4 and changed retry conditions to include 5xx responses. This caused checkout-svc to retry payment-svc requests up to 4 times with 0ms backoff, leading to a spike in upstream errors (21.8 errors per second) and checkout-svc error rate (32.26%). The payment-svc error rate (0.9273) was stable, indicating the issue was not with payment-svc itself. The deployment timeline matches the alert firing time, and the commit details confirm the change.
